column5: What does the AI system do?
column8: triage=Triage or prioritisation|admin=Scheduling or admin|scribe=Clinical notes or scribe|decision=Supports clinical decisions|other=Other

column5: Does it use health information about patients?
column15: Health information is used by the AI system.
column16: Confirm collection and use are permitted under APP 3 and APP 6 (including consent for sensitive information) and record it with your privacy team.

column5: Does a qualified clinician review AI output before it affects care?
column15: No clinician review of AI output before it affects care.
column16: Add a clinician review step and record who reviewed each output.

column5: Are patients told when AI is used in their care?
column15: Patients are not told when AI is used.
column16: Add a plain-language notice to patient information and consent material.

column5: Has the system been tested for accuracy across the patient groups you serve?
column15: Accuracy across patient groups is not tested.
column16: Test performance across age, sex and other relevant groups before go-live and after changes.

column5: Does the vendor contract stop patient data being used to train the vendor's models?
column15: Vendor may train on patient data.
column16: Get a written term that patient data is not used for training.

column5: Is there a way for staff to report AI errors or near misses?
column15: No route for reporting AI errors.
column16: Add AI errors to your existing clinical incident reporting.
